articles.summary: Anfield Energy advances JD-8 uranium-vanadium mine permitting as Colorado DRMS recommends approval, with a Board hearing set for October 14-15, 2026.
articles.title: Anfield Energy Receives Colorado DRMS Completeness Determination and Staff Recommendation for Approval of JD-8 Mine Permit; Board Hearing Set for October 14-15, 2026

articles.title: Anfield Advances Velvet-Wood Toward Active Dewatering with Utah Concept Approval and Outfall Reactivation Request
